title: The Rattenfanger
subtitle: Those rats following him shrieked and threw themselves into the sea one after another.

trails.title: Trail ① Prepare for the Ultimate
trails.description: A record on how to gain Moxie quickly. Getting Moxie quickly will allow you to cast Ultimates quickly and sway the battle in your favor.

trails.title: Trail ② An Unknown Traveller Ⅱ
trails.description: You bumped into a child. The "Storm" got in her way and changed the outside world. Solo investigations are now more dangerous.

trails.title: The Critter in a Coma
trails.description: You'll get an answer from it. Do pay attention to lies. Many creatures are skilled liars.

items.text: The Rattenfanger

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: There is no way ahead. It seems to be another dead end.
Underground, The Walden

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: There is no way ahead. It seems to be another dead end.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Huh? Hmm ... behind this wall, I hear many cheers! This is the exit. It leads to the outside!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: There are indeed many voices. Hmm? Timekeeper? I seem to hear her voice!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Hey! Anyone here? Help us please! We're trapped behind the wall!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: No. They can not hear us. Let me blast the wall!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: No way! It sounds like a banquet outside. A cheerful one! It would be bad if the rubble hit them.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Let me look through the cracks ... Hmm ... It seems we are behind the spotlight.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: The cracks are huge! Why don't I use a corrosive potion to dissolve them, so we could move the bricks!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Good idea! Let's start from the middle!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: We should get out of here as soon as possible. Timekeeper, she definitely needs my help ...

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Huh!

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Ah ha! The joy, the joy from the bottom of my heart ... ♪

items.speaker: Vip Guest
items.text: Another 19 points down? What the hell? What are they doing?

items.speaker: Thomas
items.text: Can I ... get my 5,000 back? No?

items.speaker: Guest
items.text: Hey, Forget Me Not! Is there something wrong with your chart? Today is not April Fools'!

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Ah ha? What's the matter?

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Seems no one cares about us anymore, Ms. Governor ...

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: If that is the case ... I will make your arms bleed, my lord. Will the audience be interested then?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Ugh!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The market is really dropping ahead of time. To accelerate the history like this ... is that for ...

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Huh! Can't you feel the pain? That's really annoying. Next time if I aim at your thigh, will they be more attracted?

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Pap!!

items.speaker: Thomas
items.text: Damn it! Is it going to f*****g hit the downside? I should've sold it! Go to hell!

items.speaker: Guest
items.text: My house! No, my everything! Get my money back! Give it back, you son of a b***h!

items.speaker: Vip Guest
items.text: Hello? Darling, no-no I can explain. It's just for the moment. Do you think the Wall Street bankers will just sit around and watch?

items.speaker: Vip Guest
items.text: What? Everyone is exiting! The trading volume is more than 12 million shares?!

items.speaker: Thomas
items.text: Pay you my ass! Who has the cash? You tell me, who has the cash!

items.speaker: Guest
items.text: Let me out! I'm in a hurry. I-I need to go home! I need to go home!

items.speaker: Guest
items.text: Pap!

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Heh heh! Hilarious! I'm killing people but nobody gives a damn!

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Pap pap! Pap pap!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: It's too dangerous! Why doesn’t Vertin use that blasting Bombard Ball!

items.speaker: Special Action Team Captain
items.text: No, not yet! We're fighting up close here, can't let the bomb give us away!

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Fine. Enough fun for me.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: If I don't kill you, I'm afraid we won't be able to leave tonight.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: It would be great if I met you and your "rubble" first, and so we would have not ... Forget it.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Ms. Governor, goodbye.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: She slowly raises the pistol. Her face is as pale and delicate as a sad white pigeon.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: *lights on*

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Dazzling spotlights suddenly focus on Vertin and Schneider and blind them.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Pap pap pap!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Hurried footsteps are coming toward Vertin.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper, what's going on? You are bleeding!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I'm fine. Why are you ... behind the stage? You seem well. Thank goodness.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Come here, quick! A lot of people are arguing there. Oh! Careful, you'll be knocked down!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: A slow clapping sound comes from the stage away from the fighting ring.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Those behind him ... are men of the Manus Vindictae!

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Thank you all, for giving this about-to-end world such an unforgettable curtain call.

items.speaker: Thomas
items.text: Forget Me Not?! I lost all the stocks I bought from you! How will you make up for it!

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: A very good question, dear Mr. Thomas.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: I am here to share good news with you, comparing with which, the Dow dropping more than 300 is not worth mentioning.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: The world you live in, year 1929 of the Roaring 20s, is welcoming its finale.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: And now, I invite you to wait quietly for the finale to come.

items.speaker: Thomas
items.text: Are you crazy? Do you know what you’re talk ...

items.speaker: Thomas
items.text: *casting incantation*

items.speaker: Thomas
items.text: Uggh ...

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Don't worry. He will be quiet for a while.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: The crowd is no longer noisy.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Although the party balloons, the feather decorations, and well-dressed guests still make this place seem a cheerful banquet, the whole room is filled with absolute silence.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Silence named "Fear."

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: *phone ringing*

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Hello? Oh, the Dow closed at ... 230.07. I see.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: That's it, my friends. Wall Street has collapsed.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: And the "Storm" ...

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: ... has finally come.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: At first, it's a drop of rain you can barely see.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: From the drain, from the bottom of rubber shoes, from the milk about to be dumped, they become an unknown pond.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Then, the pond becomes the raindrop. It leaves the ground without hesitation, as if trying to get rid of a pernicious habit ...

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: ... a pernicious habit of this era and society.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text:
What I said caused uproar in the crowd. 
And that habit will only grow, like a "mutation," haunting every living body.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: In the 60s, it crashed people into absurd cartoons. In the 90s, it turns our veins into cables.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: At last, all the absurdities will transform into a "Storm," and eventually "cleanse" the world.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Only the people who weren't sifted out have the right to ...

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: "Reverse," with us.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: These are the details that couldn’t be revealed to the public. Our official—Ms. Vertin, you must be familiar with it, right?

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: You know this better than anyone else ... the countdown to the sifting, has already begun.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Correct. I finally got the answer.
TO BE CONTINUED…
